events.region: Lake Superior from Grand Marais MI to Whitefish Point MI 5NM off shore to the US/Canadian border
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
Marine fog down to 1 nautical mile or less is being seen over the
eastern open waters of Lake Superior early tonight. While this
should erode away into the Canadian waters just an hour or two
after midnight EDT, be sure to navigate the sea with caution. Use
proper fog signals, and make sure all running lights are on, and
remember to use your radar and compass.

extending from 18 miles southeast of Harrison to near Ennis, moving
northeast at 25 mph.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Ennis, Norris, Jeffers, and Mcallister.
